thesis: Annual revenue and diluted EPS each grew about 11%, and cash exceeds debt. The observed price of 100 is 20 times reported annual EPS. The quarterly EPS of 2.40 lacks a comparable prior-year quarter, and the price observation predates that report. The packet gives insufficient evidence to justify an entry at 100.
uncertainty: The supplied evidence is synthetic and its origin is unauthenticated. The quarterly figure alone cannot establish an earnings trend, and the packet has no price observation after the report.
allocation_reasoning: The book has no ACME shares. Holding preserves all 100000 in cash, keeps ACME exposure at zero, and incurs no fill fee.

exit_conditions.text: Reassess entry when a comparable prior-year quarter and a fresh post-report price are available.
